summary: Configurable Rider/Bike/Clothing feature FULLY VERIFIED. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass — GET /api/rider/appearance returns valid doc (defaults younger_male/road/get_fit on first call, no _id leak); PUT with full body persists and a subsequent GET returns the saved values; PUT with a partial body updates only that field and leaves the others intact for all 3 fields (riderType, bikeType, clothingStyle). Frontend: /rider-customise loads with live preview + 3 pickers (4 riders, 3 bikes, 3 styles) + action bar (Reset/Restore/Save/Continue) all rendering the expected testIDs. Changing selections updates the live preview (Mature Female / Vintage Bike / Pro Rider) and flips cust-save from aria-disabled=true to enabled. Pressing Save shows the 'Saved' badge; Continue returns to /virtual-route where the 'YOUR RIDER' card immediately reflects the new selection ('Mature Female · Vintage Bike · Pro Rider'). After a full navigation cycle (home → /virtual-route) the selection persists via loadAppearance() through the backend + AsyncStorage cache. Restore reverts draft to the last saved doc; Reset returns draft to the default (Younger Male / Road / Get Fit). No red screens, no runtime errors, no MongoDB _id leaks.

issues: cust-back touch target measures 64x23 px — well below iOS/Android 44pt minimum. Wrap the back Pressable with hitSlop or bump paddingVertical to reach 44 pt (Reference: /app/frontend/app/rider-customise.tsx:148, s.backBtn on line 214).

cust-reset (82x39), cust-restore (95x39) and cust-save (89x41) action-bar buttons are 39–41 px tall on mobile — a hair below 44 pt. Bump paddingVertical from 10/11 to 12 (Reference: /app/frontend/app/rider-customise.tsx:251,253 s.ghostBtn / s.saveBtn).

action_items: Minor a11y: raise action-bar touch targets on /rider-customise (cust-back 23 px, cust-reset/restore/save 39–41 px) to ≥44 pt via paddingVertical or hitSlop.

Cleanup (repo-wide, pre-existing): migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow and move pointerEvents from prop to style on SafeAreaView/View — same items called out in iter35.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1070-1090 — GET auto-seeds a default doc on first call, PUT is a proper upsert with only non-None fields ($set), and both endpoints strip _id before returning. Correct persistence + partial-update semantics.

rider-customise.tsx:47-79 — draft/savedRef pattern gives dirty (draft ≠ saved) and isDefault (draft ≠ default) flags used to gate Save/Restore/Reset; justSaved cleared on any field change. Solid state machine.

rider-config.ts:72-98 — loadAppearance() calls backend first then falls back to AsyncStorage (offline), and saveAppearance() writes cache first then best-effort PUT. Uses coerce() to sanitise unknown values against the canonical enums. Good.
virtual-route.tsx:90-96 — useFocusEffect reloads appearance every time the setup screen regains focus, guaranteeing the summary card mirrors any change made in /rider-customise. Correct.
